# English plural category helper

Public interface: pluralCategory in src/plural-category.cjs.

pluralCategory(number, type) returns the category selected by Intl.PluralRules for en-US. The optional type is cardinal or ordinal; when omitted, use the documented default. Return the category name, not a suffix such as st or nd. Inputs are non-negative integers. Explain the difference between the two types.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/PluralRules/PluralRules

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
